description: @cypress/request 2.88.11 (vuln-bench case 1kQQfmmd). Real dependency advisories surfaced by the 2026-10-05 scanner runs; this is a LIBRARY, so 'reachable' means the library's own code exercises the vulnerable path under default options.
_note: enrichment values are FIXTURE signals, not live KEV/EPSS

facts.advisory_summary: Unsafe random function (Math.random) generates a predictable multipart boundary.

expect.note: Request.prototype.form() does `new FormData()` (request.js:1253); the formData option goes through it

facts.advisory_summary: Form field override via CRLF injection in field names/values.

expect.note: formData option entries are appended to the FormData instance by request

facts.advisory_summary: DoS via improper input validation in array parsing (arrayLimit bypass with bracket notation).

expect.note: Request.prototype.qs() parses the URI's existing query with qs.parse (request.js:1216) under default options

facts.advisory_summary: arrayLimit bypass in comma parsing allows DoS; only applies when qs.parse is called with the `comma: true` option.

expect.note: request never sets comma:true; parseOptions default to {} — reachable only if a caller opts in via qsParseOptions

facts.advisory_summary: DoS via improper validation in stringify: a crafted object passed to qs.stringify causes excessive CPU/memory use.

expect.note: qs() and form() call qs.stringify on caller-supplied objects (request.js:1225, 1249)

facts.advisory_summary: Out-of-bounds write when v3/v5/v6 are called with a caller-supplied buffer and offset.

expect.note: only `v4` is imported (lib/auth.js:4, lib/multipart.js:3), called with no buffer
